route.description: Repositories whose issues and pull requests go to one Linear team and, optionally, one project. Add one [[route]] table for each destination. Each repository belongs to exactly one route.

repos.description: Repositories as "owner/name", or "owner/*" for every repository of a user or organization.

team.description: The Linear team, by key ("ENG") or name. Case doesn't matter.

project.description: The Linear project, by name, for the issues ferryGL creates. The team must have access to it.

github_user.description: The GitHub CLI account to read these repositories as (gh auth token --user <name>). When set, GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN are ignored for this route.

sync.description: Which items are synced, and what ferryGL adds to the Linear issues it changes.

since.description: Ignore items not updated on GitHub since this date, such as 2026-09-01. Without it, ferryGL looks at items of any age.

label.description: The name of an existing Linear label to add to every issue ferryGL creates.

comment.description: Post a comment starting with (BY-FGL) on a Linear issue each time ferryGL changes it.

prs_created.description: Sync pull requests you opened. The other pull request roles leave them out.

prs_assigned.description: Sync someone else's pull requests assigned to you.

prs_reviewed.description: Sync someone else's pull requests you've reviewed.

review_requests.description: Sync someone else's pull requests where your review is requested.

prs_with_commits.description: Sync someone else's pull requests with a commit you wrote. This reads every pull request in scope, so it's the slowest part of a run: set since, or turn it off.

titles.description: Title templates for the Linear issues ferryGL creates. They can use {title}, {number} and {repo}. Use "{repo}#{number}" to keep GitHub titles out of Linear.

issue.description: Title for issues you created or are assigned to.

pr.description: Title for pull requests you opened.

involved.description: Title for someone else's pull requests you're part of.

copy.description: What ferryGL copies from GitHub, beyond titles, numbers, repositories, links and states.

description.description: Copy the GitHub description into the Linear issue when ferryGL creates it.

status.description: Your team's Linear workflow state names, for each status ferryGL sets. Each must exist, spelled exactly the same, in the team of every route.

todo.description: For open issues, and pull requests whose review is requested from you.

in_progress.description: For draft pull requests, and issues whose open pull requests are all drafts.

in_review.description: For open pull requests, ones you've reviewed, and issues with a pull request open for review. A new Linear issue for an open issue whose pull request was merged starts here too.

done.description: For merged pull requests, and issues closed as completed.

canceled.description: For pull requests closed unmerged, and issues closed as not planned or as duplicates.

api_key_file.description: A file holding your Linear API key. ~ is expanded. LINEAR_API_KEY takes precedence over it.
